en.headline: New chronic hives drug approved under Hong Kong's '1+' scheme
en.dek: The Department of Health said a medicine for chronic spontaneous urticaria is the 22nd new drug registered since the streamlined mechanism began in 2023.
body: The Department of Health said on Monday that another new drug had been approved for registration in Hong Kong under the "1+" mechanism, bringing the total to 22 since the scheme was launched in 2023.

The medicine is intended for chronic spontaneous urticaria, a long-term skin condition marked by unpredictable itch and hives. The department said the product had already been approved by a drug regulator in the United States. The Registration Committee under the Pharmacy and Poisons Board of Hong Kong, after reviewing clinical data and seeking local expert advice, considered that it met the relevant safety, efficacy and quality standards.

A spokesman said the condition could profoundly affect quality of life, and that the newly registered drug could provide sustained improvement in symptom control. Under the "1+" mechanism, a new drug supported by local clinical data and recognised by local experts may be registered on the basis of approval from one reference regulator instead of two.

The department said seven of the drugs approved under the mechanism had already been added to the Hospital Authority drug formulary, six of them as special drugs. Eligible patients prescribed those medicines pay the standard fee of 20 dollars every four weeks. The department has received more than 910 enquiries from over 220 pharmaceutical companies about the scheme.

zh.headline: 「1+」機制再批新藥 慢性藻麻疹治療增至22款
zh.dek: 衞生署表示，一款用於慢性自發性藻麻疹的新藥已獲批准註冊，令「1+」機制下獲批新藥增至22款。
body: 衞生署星期一表示，再有一款新藥在「1+」藥物審批機制下獲批註冊，令機制推出以來獲批新藥增至22款。
該藥用於慢性自發性藻麻疹，已獲美國藥物監管機構批核。香港藥劑業及毒藥管理局轄下註冊委員會審視申請人提交的臨床數據及相關資料，並徵詢本地專家意見後，認為符合安全、效能及素質標準，批准在港註冊。
發言人指，慢性自發性藻麻疹是一種反覆出現無法預期搗痙及風團的慢性皮膚病，可能對生活質素造成深遠影響，新藥將有助持續改善症狀。在「1+」機制下，獲本地臨床數據支持並獲本地專家認可的新藥，只需提交一個參考監管機構的批核，而無須兩個。
衞生署指，機制下獲批新藥當中，已有7款納入醫院管理局藥物名冊，其中6款屬「專用藥物」，符合特定臨床條件的病人獲處方後只需繳付標準費用，即每四星期20元。署方至今收到來自220多間藥廠超過910個查詢。
